name: sfx_board
description: ScaleFX board-side framework — server composition + one specific component-collection policy. Server side (server/): BoardServer<...Policies> variadic composer, ServiceContext interface, SystemServicePolicy concept, BoardServicePolicy (universal lifecycle/identify/status/I2C-scan), PacketReader<TDispatch> COBS framer, SfxServer<...UserPolicies> wrapper, StreamWriter (chunked CRC-16/CCITT), and ComponentServicePolicy (generic-expander runtime — servos / pwm / LEDs / battery, addressed by ComponentKind, owns the IDLE/SLAVE/DIRECT lifecycle and async-event emitters) plus BoardIdentifier (runtime-assigned, flash-persisted slave identifier). Client side (client/): CoreClient — master-side typed CommandResult API for talking to component-server slaves, observer chain for async events (SERVO_TARGET_REACHED, LED_QUEUE_DONE, BATTERY_ALERT, ...).
